name: mabStra (SMA ratio bands: mojo/fast/slow)
author: @Mablue (Masoud Azizi)
indicators: 3 SMAs for buy (mojo, fast, slow) and 3 for sell with hyperopt periods
entry_long: buy_div_min < mojoMA/fastMA < buy_div_max AND buy_div_min < fastMA/slowMA < buy_div_max
exit: sell_div_min < fastMA/mojoMA < sell_div_max AND sell_div_min < slowMA/fastMA < sell_div_max
implementation_notes: Hyperopt ratio-band approach; MA periods in params. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
